category.name: Kanban
category.description: Visual boards for team tasks and workflow stages.
category.audience: Teams across business functions managing shared tasks.
category.audienceRationale: Trello explicitly targets marketing, product, engineering, design, startups and remote teams; useful across functions without requiring a specialist role.

pricing.note: Standard USD5 per user/month annually; USD6 billed monthly. Free tier also available.

oss.name: WeKan
oss.classificationReason: Official commercial-support page explicitly states all code is MIT and no proprietary code. Hosting/support and funded features commercial; released self-hosted functionality not edition-gated.

health.rsx: Central analysis pending; GitHub metadata and release fallback inspected.

oss.name: Kanboard
oss.classificationReason: Single free MIT self-hosted product; documented automation, LDAP/OAuth, task management and analytics available without a paid edition. Third-party plugin licenses and services must be checked separately. No first-party managed hosting identified.

health.rsx: Central analysis pending; GitHub metadata and release fallback inspected.

oss.name: PLANKA
locked: Commercial third-party hosting or business account sharing across organizations requires commercial license
oss.classificationReason: Source-available candidate retained for explicitly labelled comparison only; hidden by default from OSS recommendations. Current custom Community/Fair Use License restricts fields of use; Pro files separately commercial.

health.rsx: Central analysis pending; GitHub metadata and release fallback inspected.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Comparable boards, lists, cards, labels, due dates and checklists. Trello Power-Ups and Butler rules require replacement; official page describes a Trello JSON/attachment downloader and import work, so test attachment import rather than assuming full migration.

Boards and task automation fit visual team workflows. Kanboard offers APIs/plugins; Trello Power-Ups and rules require rebuilding. No validated direct Trello importer in this review; no official native mobile client, responsive web UI available.

Source-available comparison only, hidden by default from OSS recommendations. Boards/cards/checklists and board import available, but Pro required for calendar, templates, public boards and exports; commercial third-party hosting and cross-organization business use restricted by license. Test import coverage before migration.

exclusions.name: PLANKA
exclusions.reason: Tier S: current default branch uses custom PLANKA Community License/Fair Use License, not OSI. Commercial third-party hosting and business account sharing across organizations restricted. Pro files separately commercial; everyday calendar, templates, recurring cards, public boards and exports are paid features. Not recommended as OSS despite historical reputation.
